yacl3.config.frostiful:client/display.di: When Polar Bears have been recently brushed, they show a hurt skin. Disable this feature if the texture is not compatible with your resource pack.
yacl3.config.frostiful:client/display.en: Toggles the water drip particles when wet. Has no effect if Scorchful is installed.
Toggle the frosty heart temperature display on the health bar.
yacl3.config.frostiful:client/display.ha: How intense the hand shaking should be when shivering.
yacl3.config.frostiful:client/display.re: Frosty camera overlay temperature scale start
The temperature scale below which the frosty camera overlay will begin to appear. Must be between -1 and 0 (inclusive).
yacl3.config.frostiful:client/display.sh: Whether to shake the player's hand in first person when cold.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/block.camp: Multiplies the range of the Warmth effect applied to entities around a Campfire, after adding a log. The base range is 10 blocks. Must be at least 0.
Multiplies the duration of the Warmth effect that will be applied to entities near a campfire when a log is added to it. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/block.desc: Server-side settings that relate to blocks.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/block.enab: When enabled, icicles hanging from a ceiling will have a chance to become unstable and fall.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/block.icic: Multiplies the chance that an icicle hanging from a ceiling will attempt to grow. Must be at least 0.
If icicle instability is enabled, multiplies the chance that an icicle hanging from a ceiling will become unstable and fall. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/block.sunL: Multiplies the duration that a Hot Sun Lichen will burn a warm entity that touches it. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/entity.chi: Multiplies all incoming Fire-based damage applied to Chillagers.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/entity.des: Server-side settings that relate to entities and mobs.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/entity.ena: When enabled, Pillagers are replaced by Chillagers when Patrols spawn in snowy areas.
When enabled, heavy mobs like Iron Golems and Ravagers will compact the snow they walk on, turning it to Packed Snow.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/entity.fro: Controls the amplifier of the Frost Bite effect applied by Biters. When set to automatic, the amplifier scales with world difficulty (0 in easy, 1 in normal, 3 in hard). Otherwise, locks the amplifier to the chosen difficulty's value regardless of world difficulty. Note that peaceful is not allowed, as it would have no effect.
Multiplies all incoming Fire-based damage applied to Frostologers.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/entity.str: When enabled, Strays will fire Glacial Arrows instead of Slowness arrows. Strays will drop both Slowness and Glacial arrows regardless of what this option is set to.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/environmen: Apply environment penalty when wet
When enabled, increases the rate of environmental freezing on wet players.
Environment Settings
Degrees Celsius per temperature level decrease
How many degrees Celsius per temperature level decrease. Smaller numbers makes colder areas freeze players faster. Must be positive.
Server-side settings for environment simulation.
Environment freezing soaked multiplier
Multiples the temperature reduction per tick of entities that are wet. Must be at least 0.
Environment temperature multiplier
Multiplies the temperature point reduction from environmental freezing.
Maximum snow accumulation ticks
The maximum number of ticks to record players standing in snow for the purposes of soaking them after it melts. Must be at least 0.
Max temperature for code (Celsius)
The maximum temperature that can be cold, in Celsius. May not exceed 15°C.
Minimum light level for warmth
The minimum block light level that is considered to be well-lit and warm. Must be at least 0.
On fire dry rate
Rate at which to decrease soaking points per tick to entities on fire. Must be at least 0. Has no effect if Scorchful is loaded.
On fire warm rate
Rate at which to increase temperature points per tick to entities that are cold and on fire. Must be at least 0.
On fire warm rate
Rate at which to decrease temperature points per tick to entities that are cold and standing in Powder Snow. Must be at least 0.
Rain wetness increase
Rate at which to increase soaking points per tick to entities standing in rain. Must be at least 0. Has no effect if Scorchful is loaded.
Standing in water wetness increase
Rate at which to increase soaking points per tick to entities standing in water. Must be at least 0. Has no effect if Scorchful is loaded.
Warmth per light level
Rate at which to increase temperature points per tick to entities that are cold and standing in a well-lit area, per level of light. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/freezing.c: How many temperature points to add each tick to underwater entities with the Conduit Power effect. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/freezing.d: When enabled, players will receive environmental temperature reductions from exposure in cold biomes. This can also be toggled on a per-world basis with the game rule frostiful:do_passive_freezing.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/freezing.f: How many temperature points to remove from entities that collide with a Freezing Wind. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/freezing.h: How many temperature points to add each tick to entities that are standing on hot floor blocks like Magma. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/freezing.m: Does not allow an entity to be frozen if their freezing temperature scale is greater than this number. Must be between 0 and 1 (inclusive)
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/freezing.p: The interval, in ticks, between applications of passive freezing to players. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/freezing.s: The temperature scale below which entities will begin to shiver. Must be between -1 and 0 (inclusive).
How many temperature points to add each tick to entities that are shivering. Must be at least 0.
Soaking percent from Splash Water Potion. Must be between 0 and 1 (inclusive)
When a player is below this food level, the player will stop receiving warmth from shivering to prevent starvation. Must be between 0 and 20 (inclusive).
How many temperature points to add to entities that touch Sun Lichen, per level of heat. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/icicle.des: Server-side settings for icicle related mechanics.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/icicle.fro: The temperature point reduction applied to a target struck by a Glacial Arrow. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/icicle.ici: The temperature point reduction applied to a target that falls on an icicle or is struck by a falling icicle. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/icicle.thr: The temperature point reduction applied to a target struck by a Thrown Icicle. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/item.desc: Server-side settings that relate to items.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/item.enabl: When enabled, icicles will be able to be thrown.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/item.frost: Multiplies the cooldown time of the Frost Wand after casting a spell. Must be at least 0.
Multiplies the time that an entity struck by a Frost Wand is rooted in place. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/item.maxFr: Multiplies the maximum distance (in blocks) that a spell fired from a Frost Wand can travel before exploding. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/item.packe: How much damage a Packed Snowball applies to targets. Must be at least 0.
How much damage a Packed Snowball applies to a target that is a vulnerable type (Strider, Blaze, Magma Cube) when hit. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/item.skate: Ice Skate Upgrade Template generation chance in Igloos
The chance of an Ice Skate Upgrade Template generating in an Igloo chest. Must be between 0 and 1 (inclusive). Requires a restart after changing!
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/item.throw: The damage a thrown Icicle applies to targets. Must be at least 0.
How much damage a thrown Icicle applies to a target that is a vulnerable type (Strider, Blaze, Magma Cube) when hit. Must be at least 0.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/item.warmi: Multiplies the duration of the Warmth mob effect applied to entities after consuming food items that belong to the item tag #frostiful:warm_foods
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/temperatur: Multiplies the final temperature point change of all non-environment cooling sources like powder snow and glacial arrows.
Multiplies the final temperature point change of an environment temperature change.
Frostologer cooling from Frost Wand hit multiplier
Multiplies the number of temperature points the Frostologer removes from a themselves after hitting a target with a Frost Spell.
Multiplies the number of temperature points the Frostologer removes from nearby entities each tick when casting their Blizzard spell.
Multiplies the final temperature point change of all non-environment heating sources like fire and sun lichen.
Multiplies the number of temperature points a Packed Snowball removes from a target when hit.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/weather.en: Enable freezing wind in the air
When enabled, allows freezing winds to appear high up in the air.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/weather.fr: When enabled, freezing winds will destroy exposed fire blocks (includes torches!).
Sets how freezing winds should spawn. Points create small one-off explosions of wind, entity creates an entity that rolls across the landscape, and none disables the feature entirely.
yacl3.config.frostiful:common/weather.ic: When enabled, icicles will form on the underside of full-face blocks near the surface of the world during weather.
